## Decisions

- Use IBM Plex Sans for interface text and IBM Plex Mono for code.
- Keep editor and file panes opaque; reserve glass blur for window chrome.
- Adapt 21st tree-view patterns through the existing @pierre/trees renderer.
- Keep the cursor-reactive Tux mascot and both appearance themes.
- References: [Tree Code Viewer](https://21st.dev/@uilayout.contact/components/tree-code-viewer), [File Tree](https://21st.dev/@justinlevinedotme/components/file-tree), [File Viewer](https://21st.dev/@bankkroll/components/file-viewer).
